select.name: Select
select.description: Pick edges, faces and objects. Shift+click adds or takes away, Ctrl+click adds, Shift+Ctrl+click takes away; the same with a box.

line.name: Line
line.description: Draw edges point by point; closing a loop makes a face.

freehand.name: Freehand
freehand.description: Drag to sketch a curve; a stroke that ends where it began closes into a face.

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.description: Draw a rectangle from two opposite corners.

rotated_rect.name: Rotated Rect
rotated_rect.description: Draw a rectangle at any angle and in any plane: a base edge, then the width.

circle.name: Circle
circle.description: Draw a circle from its centre and radius.

polygon.name: Polygon
polygon.description: Draw a regular polygon from its centre and radius; type a number followed by «s» to change the sides.

arc.name: Arc
arc.description: Draw an arc from its two ends, then pull out its bulge.

arc3.name: 3-Point Arc
arc3.description: Draw an arc that passes through three points.

center_arc.name: Center Arc
center_arc.description: Draw an arc from its centre: the centre, where the arc starts, then the angle it sweeps.

pie.name: Pie
pie.description: Draw an arc from its centre whose two radii close it into a slice-shaped face.

pushpull.name: Push / Pull
pushpull.description: Push or pull a face to extrude it into a solid or cut it back.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Draw a copy of a face's outline at an even distance inside or outside it — walls with thickness.

move.name: Move
move.description: Move the selection, or what you click, to a new place; Ctrl leaves a copy behind.

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.description: Turn the selection around a centre with the protractor; Ctrl leaves a copy behind.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: Resize the selection by dragging the grips of its box; the corners keep its proportions.

flip.name: Flip
flip.description: Mirror the selection across its red, green or blue plane.

followme.name: Follow Me
followme.description: Sweep a face along a path of edges — mouldings, pipes, turned shapes.

fillet.name: Fillet 3D
fillet.description: Round the edges of a solid to the radius you set.

paint.name: Paint
paint.description: Click faces to paint them with the chosen material.

dimension.name: Dimension
dimension.description: Place a dimension that shows the distance between two points.

eraser.name: Eraser
eraser.description: Click or drag over edges to erase them, together with the faces they bound.

tape.name: Tape Measure
tape.description: Measure distances, or pull guide lines off edges to draw against.

protractor.name: Protractor
protractor.description: Measure angles and place guide lines at an angle.

text.name: Text
text.description: Place a text with a leader pointing at the model; it suggests the length, area or coordinates of what you click.

geopath.name: Path
geopath.description: Trace a path over the base map — a road, a boundary — to profile or measure it; the model is left untouched.

section.name: Section Plane
section.description: Place a plane that cuts the model open to show its inside.

position_camera.name: Position Camera
position_camera.description: Click where to stand and the eye goes there at a person's height; drag to also say where to look.

walk.name: Walk
walk.description: Drag to walk through the model at eye height: up and down go forward and back, left and right turn.

look_around.name: Look Around
look_around.description: Drag to turn your head; the eye stays where it is.

first_person.name: First Person
first_person.description: Walk as in a game: W, A, S and D move, the mouse turns the head.

outer_shell.name: Outer Shell
outer_shell.description: Merge the selected solids into one, keeping only their outer skin.

solid_union.name: Union
solid_union.description: Join solids into a single solid.

solid_subtract.name: Subtract
solid_subtract.description: Cut the first solid clicked out of the second, and remove the first.

solid_trim.name: Trim
solid_trim.description: Cut the first solid clicked out of the second, and keep the first.

solid_intersect.name: Intersect
solid_intersect.description: Keep only the part where the solids overlap.

solid_split.name: Split
solid_split.description: Split two overlapping solids into their separate parts and their common part.

zoom_window.name: Zoom Window
zoom_window.description: Drag a box to zoom to that region.

section_cuts.name: Section Cuts
section_cuts.description: Cut the model open at its planes.
